expectations.text: no_metadata_extraction: Agent does NOT try to extract metadata or rename — it's a URL, not a file
expectations.evidence: Trace explicitly states: 'Step 2 is scoped to files only. For a URL, there is no look-at call, no attempt to fetch the page, no renaming.'

expectations.text: daily_note_markdown_link: Daily note uses markdown link format [Title](URL), not wiki-link
expectations.evidence: Entry is '- [ ] [SEC Enforcement Update](https://...)' — markdown link format, not wiki-link.

expectations.text: readwise_save: Agent saves URL to Readwise Reader with appropriate tag
expectations.evidence: Step 5 calls 'readwise save URL --tag reading-inbox' — correct command with tag.

expectations.text: daily_note_under_reading: Daily note entry is inserted under # Reading heading
expectations.evidence: Step 4c uses Read + Edit to insert under # Reading. References Iron Law against daily:append.
